text: The food wasn't really something I could judge. The whole experience was a mess. We got there at 7:20 on Sunday because we needed time before our show at 10. The hotel buffet's digital waitlist is ridiculous. We were told to come back to pay at 8:23, but we waited till 8:40, and then the staff told us we would probably not be seated till 9:15. They didn't offer any solutions. The manager could have let us know about the long wait times, or at least past the payment time, if they had a solution. That would have saved us hours. Basic hospitality failed. If I could give it 0 stars I would.
